description: Flora's token for a one-time escape. First speak to her in her manor and explicitly confirm readiness; receiving or wearing armor alone is not enough. An existing complete or packed suit has its own readiness response. Equip and pack before activating this charm in the registered manor. A confirmation starts the attack: guardians delay Zodd and Grunbeld while you escape through the western road or southern garden. It needs no power, does not teleport you and cannot restart a completed attack.

use_action.menu_text: Begin the escape from Flora's manor
